---
title: Environment Physics
---

Launch physical projectiles into the room that dynamically collide with and bounce off the live environment depth mesh using Rapier3D physics.

### Desktop Controls (User Mode)

- **Launch Projectile:** Left-click to fire a physics projectile in the direction you are looking.
- **Move Camera:** Use <kbd>W</kbd>, <kbd>A</kbd>, <kbd>S</kbd>, <kbd>D</kbd> to move forward, left, backward, and right.
- **Elevate Camera:** Use <kbd>Q</kbd> and <kbd>E</kbd> to move down and up.
- **Rotate:** Right-click and drag the mouse to look around.

### XR Controls

- **Launch Projectile:** Ray-pinch with hands or pull the controller trigger to fire projectiles into the physical room.
